parameters.name: DescriptorAvailable
parameters.description: When {{true}}, the Complex Descriptor recorded has been received from the target device.

parameters.name: Language
parameters.description: Specifies the ISO 639-1 language code as defined in {{bibref|ISO639-1}}.

parameters.name: CharacterSet
parameters.description: Specifies the ISO 646 character set as defined in {{bibref|ISO646-1991}}.

parameters.name: ManufacturerName
parameters.description: Specifies the name of the manufacturer of the ZigBee device.

parameters.name: ModelName
parameters.description: Specifies the name of the manufacturer's model of the ZigBee device.

parameters.name: SerialNumber
parameters.description: Specifies the manufacturer's serial number of the ZigBee device.

parameters.name: DeviceURL
parameters.description: Specifies the {{datatype}} through which more information relating to the ZigBee device can be obtained.

parameters.name: Icon
parameters.description: The icon field contains an octet string which carries the data for an icon that can represent the ZigBee device. The format of the icon MUST be a 32-by-32-pixel PNG image.

parameters.name: IconURL
parameters.description: Specifies the {{datatype}} through which the icon for the ZigBee device can be obtained.

object.description: The {{object}} object is an optional descriptor that describes extended capabilities of the ZigBee device as defined in {{bibref|ZigBee2007|section 2.3.2.6 Complex Descriptor}}.
